what: §7.3b duel 'a follower hitting a dropped cone loses a little time and is never wrecked' (P1-S08). Two Cruz Missiles wait out their 1.5 s spawn protection parked apart (a protected car touches only the world), then are placed on the greybox's back straight at 20 m/s on the autopilot's line, the follower 20 m behind the leader. The leader's player flicks ACTION down once: a cone lands 1.5 m behind its bumper, in the follower's path, and the follower drives into it. Against the same run without the ACTION stick (no cone), the follower is a little behind at the end and stays upright and unwrecked; the leader isn't slowed by dropping it.
